findings.text: the reviewed run's manifest test_logs field carries two malformed entries in which a second absolute path is concatenated onto the run directory, so a reader opening those two entries finds nothing; the same logs are named correctly elsewhere in the field so no evidence is lost, but the field should name openable paths.

VERDICT goal: the node goal is that every run: wait a request holds resolves through its project so a landed upstream releases it; this delta takes the one registry read the previous review found duplicated and makes reckon/crew/runs.py:1763 the single owner of the project-to-checkout-root mapping, with queue_admission._mount_view (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1765) delegating to it.
VERDICT done_when: the node's measure is the plan's five cases and two controls in tests/test_a_run_wait_names_its_project.py; the manifest names the gate command and gate-head-3.log records REVISION 417784c569 with 9 passed EXIT=0, and the single-reader control log shows the added case reddening.
VERDICT write_paths: the delta touches four files — reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, reckon/crew/runs.py, tests/test_a_run_wait_names_its_project.py and the landing fragment — and all four are named by this review's own scope; the dispatch's original fence omitted reckon/crew/runs.py, and the manifest records the coordinator's widen of the claim.
VERDICT manifest: read; it names the gate command and its logs, five negative controls each with a bare EXIT= last line, and states the consumer sweep as partial rather than complete.
VERDICT diff: read all three commits against 466658b94b — 4879eeb731 threads one MountView through the derivation and gives runs._promoted_record_project a roots keyword, 417784c569 replaces _mount_view's re-derivation with a call to runs._mounted_project_roots_and_failure and adds the failures out-parameter, 7cba0e9666 is docs-only.
VERDICT correctness: the readers now share one mapping and one failure string; an unreadable registry reaches the wait derivation as a re-read and is not turned into a discard verdict, and a readable one resolves as before.
VERDICT completeness: the fold is complete — the duplication and the divergent exception handling the prior review named are both gone, with a case asserting both readers report the same reason from separate derivations.
VERDICT scope: every changed path is inside the four paths this review covers and inside the coordinator's widened claim; no unrelated code moved.
VERDICT evidence: gate-head-3.log is at 417784c569 with 9 passed EXIT=0, and the head commit 7cba0e9666 changes only the fragment, so the recorded gate covers the code at head.
VERDICT naming: no plan, sprint, ticket or version identifiers appear in the added symbols, docstrings, test names or fragment ids.
